rationale: Retain the directional predictors for their demonstrated component benefit: all six dispatched predictor cases improve 36.04–49.73%, and ten of twenty-two complete I4 caller cases improve 3.41–7.01%, with no significant caller regression and zero allocations. All correctness, stream-parity, decoder, fallback and cross-build gates pass. The first codec pass was mixed (ShortClip +1.44%, Road QP20 −1.52%); the single predeclared longer confirmation found all five one-slice cases inconclusive and did not reproduce the ShortClip regression. This supports retaining a bounded component optimization, not claiming a demonstrated full-frame gain or equal performance. All six incremental full-frame results remain inconclusive; native parity remains unmet. Both passes are preserved separately and no further significance-seeking repeat is planned.
